social_world.value: Publishing industry hierarchy: established authors commissioned for anthologies; literary journals vs. pulp/genre magazines; editors gatekeeping genre fiction from prestige venues like The New Yorker
social_world.quote: The New Yorker frowns on genre fiction, Playboy in recent years has eschewed it altogether, and many literary journals are reluctant

media_and_audience.value: The anthology series itself functions as a repackaging mechanism: 1,500+ stories examined annually, culled and reframed as prestige literature, dissolving genre boundaries for a general literary audience
media_and_audience.quote: The best writing makes it into the book. Fame, friendship, original venue, reputation, subject—none of it matters.
